1 # 2 Yoh 1 Me, ɔpanin no twerɛ kɔma ɔdɔfo Gaio a medɔ no nokorɛ mu.
2Ɔdɔfo, mebɔ mpaeɛ sɛ, adeɛ nyinaa mu, ɛnsi wo yie, na nya ahoɔden sɛdeɛ asi wo kra yie no. 3#2 Yoh 4 Ɛberɛ a anuanom bi baeɛ, na wɔbɛdii wo nokorɛdie ho adanseɛ, sɛdeɛ wonam nokorɛ mu no, m’ani gyee sɛ. 4Menni anigyeɛ a ɛsene yei, sɛ mete sɛ me mma nam nokorɛ mu. 5Ɔdɔfo, deɛ woyɛ ma anuanom a wɔyɛ ahɔhoɔ no, ne kwan so ara ne no. 6#Tito 3.13 Wɔn nso adi wo dɔ no ho adanseɛ asafo no anim. Na wogya wɔn kwan sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ, Nyankopɔn anim a, na woayɛ no yie. 7#Aso 20.35; 1 Ko 9.12; 9.15 Na ne din nti na wɔnam, na wɔannye amanaman mufoɔ no hɔ biribiara. 8#Heb 13.2 Enti na ɛsɛ yɛn sɛ yɛgye saa nkurɔfoɔ no, na yɛayɛ yɔnko adwumayɛfoɔ ama nokorɛ no.
Diotrefe ne Demetrio
9Metwerɛ mekɔmaa asafo no. Na Diotrefe a ɔrepɛ wɔn mu panin adie no nnye yɛn nto mu. 10Yei nti, sɛ meba a, mɛkae ne nnwuma a ɔyɛ no, sɛ ɔkeka yɛn ho nsɛmmɔne, na yei mpo annɔɔso amma no, na ɔno ara nnye anuanom no nto mu, na ɔsi wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ saa no kwan, na ɔtu wɔn firi asafo no mu. 11#1 Yoh 3.6; 3.9 Ɔdɔfo, nhwɛ bɔne nsua, na mmom hwɛ papa sua. Deɛ ɔyɛ papa no firi Nyankopɔn mu, na deɛ ɔyɛ bɔne no nhunuu Onyankopɔn.

pageProps.chapterText:
Me, ɔpanin no twerɛ kɔma ɔdɔfo Gaio a medɔ no nokorɛ mu.
Ɔdɔfo, mebɔ mpaeɛ sɛ, adeɛ nyinaa mu, ɛnsi wo yie, na nya ahoɔden sɛdeɛ asi wo kra yie no. Ɛberɛ a anuanom bi baeɛ, na wɔbɛdii wo nokorɛdie ho adanseɛ, sɛdeɛ wonam nokorɛ mu no, m’ani gyee sɛ. Menni anigyeɛ a ɛsene yei, sɛ mete sɛ me mma nam nokorɛ mu. Ɔdɔfo, deɛ woyɛ ma anuanom a wɔyɛ ahɔhoɔ no, ne kwan so ara ne no. Wɔn nso adi wo dɔ no ho adanseɛ asafo no anim. Na wogya wɔn kwan sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ, Nyankopɔn anim a, na woayɛ no yie. Na ne din nti na wɔnam, na wɔannye amanaman mufoɔ no hɔ biribiara. Enti na ɛsɛ yɛn sɛ yɛgye saa nkurɔfoɔ no, na yɛayɛ yɔnko adwumayɛfoɔ ama nokorɛ no.

Metwerɛ mekɔmaa asafo no. Na Diotrefe a ɔrepɛ wɔn mu panin adie no nnye yɛn nto mu. Yei nti, sɛ meba a, mɛkae ne nnwuma a ɔyɛ no, sɛ ɔkeka yɛn ho nsɛmmɔne, na yei mpo annɔɔso amma no, na ɔno ara nnye anuanom no nto mu, na ɔsi wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ saa no kwan, na ɔtu wɔn firi asafo no mu. Ɔdɔfo, nhwɛ bɔne nsua, na mmom hwɛ papa sua. Deɛ ɔyɛ papa no firi Nyankopɔn mu, na deɛ ɔyɛ bɔne no nhunuu Onyankopɔn.
Demetrio deɛ, wɔn nyinaa di ne ho adanseɛ wɔ nokorɛ mu, na yɛn nso yɛdi ne ho adanseɛ, na monim sɛ yɛn adanseɛ yɛ nokorɛ.

Anka mewɔ nsɛm pii metwerɛ, nanso mempɛ sɛ mede adubire ne twerɛdua metwerɛ mebrɛ mo. Na m’ani da so sɛ mɛhu mo ntɛm na yɛde ano ne ano akasa. Asomdwoeɛ nka mo. Nnamfonom no kyeakyea mo. Bobɔ nnamfonom no din mmaako mmaako kyea wɔn.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
